results.system_description: Varbench Heisenberg/chain_20_O: spin-1/2 Heisenberg model, Pauli convention, J = 1
results.source_location: Varbench data release, file Heisenberg/chain_20_O.md, row "RNN" (commit 390a21e)
results.eligibility_evidence: Energy of a neural-network state optimized and evaluated with variational Monte Carlo (NetKet) by the Varbench authors and published with arXiv:2302.04919; columns Energy, Sigma (statistical error) and Energy Variance. Script: https://github.com/varbench/methods/blob/main/scripts/Heisenberg/chain_20_O/vmc_rnn.sh
results.notes: Varbench defines the Heisenberg model with Pauli matrices, H = J sum sigma_i · sigma_j (NetKet's Heisenberg operator); this instance uses S = sigma/2, so the printed energy and error bar are multiplied by convention_factor 0.25 and the variance by 0.0625. The RNN script does not fix the magnetization; the ground state of the even chain is a singlet with total Sz = 0.

results.system_description: Varbench TFIsing/chain_32_P_1: transverse-field Ising model, Pauli matrices, J = 1, Gamma = 1
results.source_location: Varbench data release, file TFIsing/chain_32_P_1.md, row "RBM (alpha = 1)" (commit 390a21e)
results.eligibility_evidence: Energy of a neural-network state optimized and evaluated with variational Monte Carlo (NetKet) by the Varbench authors and published with arXiv:2302.04919; columns Energy, Sigma (statistical error) and Energy Variance. Script: https://github.com/varbench/methods/blob/main/scripts/TFIsing/chain_32_P_1/vmc_rbm.sh
results.notes: Varbench writes H = J sum sigma^z sigma^z + Gamma sum sigma^x; the NetKet script uses IsingJax with J = -1, which is this instance's Hamiltonian. On the even ring the two are related by flipping every other spin and a global rotation, with the same spectrum, so no factor is needed.

issues: Not included: the RBM rows of TFIsing/chain_10_O_1, chain_10_P_1 and chain_32_P_0.5, whose energies lie 10.4, 6.8 and 3.8 error bars below the exact energy in the same file, so they cannot be variational energies with the stated error.
